summary: Frontend-only testing of Vivek Nishad portfolio (React static site). issues: Repeated Lenis warning: 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position, like relative/fixed/absolute to ensure scroll offset is calculated correctly.' Non-blocking but noisy; consider adding position: relative to the Lenis wrapper/body element.

critical_code_review_comments: Project cards use <article> with onClick+useNavigate rather than <a href>; functional but worsens accessibility & right-click 'open in new tab'. Consider wrapping in <Link> for better semantics/SEO.
Lenis smooth-scroll emits a warning about container position being static. Add `position: relative` to the wrapper to silence and ensure correct offset math.
